apps.localizedDescription: Browse, RSVP, and check in to NYIT campus events. Faculty can create and manage events. Scan QR codes at the door for instant check-in.

permissions.usageDescription: Used to scan QR codes for event check-in.
Used to show your location on the campus map and provide walking directions.
Used to send event reminders and announcements.

versions.localizedDescription:
v1.9.1 — Polish + conflict guard.

• Apple-style polish across the map, feed, profile and calendar (refined typography, softer shadows, larger radii, glass-effect controls)
• Map: Parking toggle is now an inline filter chip; live-now badge upgraded to a glass pill
• Calendar: hosted/RSVP'd/open events now appear with a date chip and status badge
• Conflict guard: students can no longer RSVP to events that overlap with another RSVP — a clear message points back to the conflicting event
• Fixed bottom overflow on the 'Tonight at NYIT' cards in the For You feed
• Removed image upload from event creation while we wire up storage
• Removed past-event toggles from feed and map for a focused upcoming-only view

v1.9.0 — Real-time everywhere + smart reminders.

• Feed: live ticker keeps Today/Tomorrow/'Starts in X min' labels accurate; events no longer appear twice across Smart Picks / Tonight / featured-pick sections
• My Events, attendee lists, and the super-admin dashboard now stream live (no more pull-to-refresh needed)
• Lock-screen reminders 1 day, 1 hour, and 15 min before each event you RSVP'd to (with location)
• Server-side RSVP / waitlist / check-in counts (no more drift between devices)
• Automatic waitlist promotion when a seat opens
• Nightly cleanup archives ended events and prunes old notifications
v1.8.0 — Bug fixes and Firebase improvements.

• AR Navigate — camera overlay guides you to the venue
• Announcement dismissal persists across sessions
• Dashboard: Live/Upcoming/Past tabs, full-screen stats
• Feed layout polish and safe-area fixes
v1.4.0 - New campus building map pins, improved map view, back button fixes, QR check-in improvements, scheduled reminders, iPad support.
v1.3.0 - Always require login, hidden past events, study groups, admin improvements.
